malta/review.text: Malta's delegate described the Focal Point as gathering information for sanctions committees. The adopted text assigns report review to a working group, not sanctions committees, creating a mismatch in the decision-making body.

malta/authority.text: Malta's Focal Point gathers info; the Council assigns it a confidential report. Malta's Focal Point assists committees; the Council assigns the Focal Point a confidential factual report without a recommendation.

a3plus/review.text: The delegate preferred a time-bound review; the Council adopted a continuous review with twice-yearly reporting, establishing a working group to execute this ongoing mandate.
